'''''Erica gracilis''''' is a plant belonging to the genus ''[[Erica (plant)|Erica]]'' and forming part of the [[fynbos]].<ref>http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1820-39820 REDLIST Sanbi</ref> The species is endemic to the [[Western Cape]].<ref>http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:328805-1 Plants of the World Online</ref>
